resources.string: Sensitivity is calculated the same way like Oref0, but you can specify timeframe to the past. Minimal carb absorption is calculated from max carb absorption time from preferences.
Sensitivity is calculated from 8h or 24h data in the past (using either which is more sensitive). Carbs (if not absorbed) are cut after time specified in preferences. Plugin also calculates UAM.

Sensitivity is calculated as a weighted average from deviations. Newer deviations have higher weight. Minimal carb absorption is calculated from max carb absorption time from preferences. This algorithm is the fastest in following sensitivity changes.
UAM disabled because it rely on Oref1 sensitivity plugin
Time in hours where is expected all carbs from meal will be absorbed
Amount of hours in the past for sensitivity detection (carbs absorption time is excluded)

Default value: 1.2\nThis is a multiplier cap for autosens (and soon autotune) to set a 20%% max limit on how high the autosens ratio can be, which in turn determines how high autosens can adjust basals, how low it can adjust ISF, and how low it can set the BG target.
Default value: 0.7\nThe other side of the autosens safety limits, putting a cap on how low autosens can adjust basals, and how high it can adjust ISF and BG targets.

Default value: 3.0 (AMA) or 8.0 (SMB). This is a setting for default carb absorption impact per 5 minutes. The default is an expected 3mg/dl/5min. This affects how fast COB are decayed, and how much carb absorption is assumed in calculating future predicted BG, when BG is falling more than expected, or not rising as much as expected.
Time at which any meal is considered absorbed. Remaining carbs will be cut off.
Enable dynamic sensitivity (ISF) calculation based on TDD and BG
Use Total Daily Dose to anchor dynamic ISF calculation
Fall back to oref1 autosens when TDD data is insufficient
BG level at which ISF equals the profile value
Scale factor for TDD-based ISF (100%% = no adjustment)
Adjust TDD-based ISF by 24H/7D sensitivity ratio
How quickly ISF adjusts with BG changes (0-200%%, default 100)
BG level above which ISF increase slows down
Use profile ISF as baseline instead of TDD calculation
